notes.title: Update 1.29
notes.notes: In this update, we fixed an issue where players might not have all resolution options available in the game settings.

notes.title: Update 1.27
notes.notes:
In this update we have removed the lags that could occur at the beginning and end of cutscenes.

Now everything is finally fine :)

notes.title: Update 1.25
notes.notes:
Hi there!

In our update 1.25, we added support for new Nvidia technologies, including DLSS 4, as well as updated versions of Frame Generation and Reflex.

We also fixed the errors that users reported to us.

Thanks to everyone who helps us find flaws in our game! We read every comment and try to make the game better for you.

After the release of the update, we are getting back to work on our new co-op project. We will be happy to share details about it in the coming months.

Take care and see you soon!
